source_title: Is Etsy Still Worth It In 2026

snippets.snippet_text: "Here is where I get honest in a way that a lot of content creators do not. My revenue went down. In 2024, I did $135,000 in revenue from my Etsy print on demand shop. In 2025, that number dropped to $109,000. My profit margin is around 45%. And yes, I know that is still a lot of money, and I know that some people reading this would be absolutely thrilled with $49,050 profit from a side business they run from their laptop."

"The rise of AI tools made it incredibly easy to generate designs, write product descriptions, and spin up listings at a pace that was simply not possible before. That sounds great on the surface, right? Faster creation, more listings, more opportunities to be found. The problem is that ease of creation applies to everyone equally. So now you have an enormous volume of shops listing products at a rate the market has never seen before."
